reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a recruitment walkthrough for IBM technical support roles, including job information and IBM careers application links. The described frames show an IBM Technical Support Representative listing, job requirements, and Apply Now controls. The application flow requests ordinary contact and preference information and does not present payment, investment-return, credential-password, or guaranteed-outcome solicitation.

citations.quote: IBM Recruitment 2019 I Technical Support Associate I Apply Online I Learn Technical
Friends, get the information about the new job from Private Job IBM.
How to apply.
It's easy to apply without any fees.

opening.argument: The presentation links an easy, low-barrier employment opportunity to a specific viewer action: clicking through to apply. The speaker emphasizes a “new job,” says the application is easy and without fees, and directs viewers to the description for the application link. That pairing can function as a solicitation for personal information and participation even though the material does not establish what applicants ultimately receive or whether the advertised opportunity is genuine. The visible IBM-branded page still shows an “APPLY NOW” pathway, so the central practical outcome is to move viewers from the video into an external application flow.

citations.quote: Friends, get the information about the new job from Private Job IBM.
It's easy to apply without any fees.
The link to apply for the job will be in the description and you can apply for it

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the presence of an IBM-looking page as proof of legitimacy, but the page alone does not establish that the video’s external path is safe or that the advertised opportunity will produce the implied employment outcome. “Without any fees” addresses payment, not the collection or use of applicant information. The speaker’s repeated instruction to click and apply is precisely the participation pathway the defense minimizes.

citations.quote: It's easy to apply without any fees.
The link to apply for the job will be in the description and you can apply for it

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument converts a normal job application into an unsupported reward claim. The material identifies a specific IBM recruitment subject, not a free cash or asset offer, and the visible page is a conventional job listing with an “APPLY NOW” control. The quoted statements show how to apply, but they do not show deception, an unearned reward, or an outcome guarantee. “Without any fees” also cuts against the proposed payment-based concern.

citations.quote: IBM Recruitment 2019 I Technical Support Associate I Apply Online I Learn Technical
Qualification : BE / B.Tech ( CSE / EEE / ECE )
How to apply.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: the video sends viewers to links in the description, presents an easy application process, and the description includes multiple unrelated recruitment links, a Telegram link, and an affiliate disclosure. The speaker also says the opportunity is a new private job and repeatedly directs viewers to click. That combination creates a low-friction funnel from promotional claims to external participation, while the supplied material does not establish who controls every linked destination or what happens after submission. A careful reviewer can therefore treat the apparent job information as a potentially deceptive acquisition flow rather than simply neutral education.

citations.quote: Friends, get the information about the new job from Private Job IBM.
The link to apply for the job will be in the description and you can apply for it
Telegram Link : https://t.me/getjobupdate (Affiliate Link)
please like and share my videos subscribe my channel

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense identifies ordinary-looking fields and controls but does not resolve the broader distribution pattern: viewers are sent through description links alongside a Telegram destination and an explicitly disclosed affiliate link. Those details do not prove fraud individually, yet their combination with a low-friction job pitch supports caution. The absence of an explicit payment request is not proof that no harmful solicitation occurs.

citations.quote: Telegram Link : https://t.me/getjobupdate (Affiliate Link)
It's easy to apply without any fees.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited links are not evidence of a scam mechanism. The description identifies the Telegram item as an affiliate link, and the recruitment material supplies role-specific application URLs rather than a deposit, wallet, credential, or investment instruction. Multiple links and a call to subscribe may be promotional, but they do not establish a free reward, asset acquisition, or deceptive outcome. The risk argument relies on suspicion beyond what the supplied content shows.

citations.quote: Apply Online Technical Support Associate : https://careers.ibm.com/ShowJob/Id/775900/Technical%20Support%20Associate
Telegram Link : https://t.me/getjobupdate (Affiliate Link)
It's easy to apply without any fees.

opening.argument: Although the video adopts an instructional tone, its practical role is promotional: it names a specific employer and roles, tells viewers that eligible people can apply, points them to the description, and walks them toward the application control. The description also asks viewers to like, share, subscribe, and press the bell icon. This is not merely neutral explanation of recruitment; it steers viewers toward external participation and channel engagement while presenting the opportunity as easy to pursue. That promotional funnel is consistent with a low-barrier acquisition scheme even though the video does not independently establish the promised employment result.

citations.quote: IBM Invites Online Application For The Post Of Technical Support Associate & Technical Support Representative
How to apply.
The link to apply for the job will be in the description and you can apply for it
please like and share my videos subscribe my channel and press the bell icon

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the content instructional does not answer its promotional mechanics. The video does not just explain a general hiring process; it directs viewers to a particular application route and couples that route with requests for engagement. The defense’s description of routine fields overlooks that the video’s persuasive purpose is to move viewers off-platform into participation, without independently verifying the claimed opportunity.

citations.quote: The link to apply for the job will be in the description and you can apply for it
please like and share my videos subscribe my channel and press the bell icon

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion does not equal a scam under the stated category. The supplied description gives role titles and qualifications, while the visible material shows a job listing and an ordinary application control. Engagement requests may promote the channel, but they do not link a reward or income payment to recruiting others, purchasing something, or surrendering funds. The argument therefore shows steering toward a job application, not the required scam promise-action relationship.
